sweep_config_space.description: 3 × 3 × 4 = 36 configurations. Cartesian product of the three axes below. T12 implementer runs each config and reports per-config posterior summary + diagnostics; deviation from baseline (center value of each axis) is the sensitivity check.

tau_arm_prior_scale.note: Per Priya Move 1: original AUC-calibrated {0.025, 0.05, 0.10} multiplied by k=5.72 (signed pooled). Baseline 0.29 corresponds to §2.1 ratified prior Normal(0, 0.30). Rounded sweep values 0.14 / 0.29 / 0.57.

half_cauchy_scale.note: UNCHANGED from T10 commit ca77505 §2.5. Ji-Hoon Move 1 round-2 ratified that HalfCauchy is operationally scale-invariant under the response-variable shift; the heavy tail accommodates empirical between-sector heterogeneity at the new scale without prior surgery.

mu_center.note: Per Roshani Move 2 + Ji-Hoon co-sign: was T10 {0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.53} AUC-mixture-derived. Replaced with additive offsets {0, +0.15, +0.30, +0.50} on mu_empirical. Endpoint 0.668 corresponds to 1.90 σ above mu_empirical — stresses prior at upper edge without leaving supported territory (Ji-Hoon Move 2 verification).

convergence_diagnostics_per_config.note: All 5 diagnostics must PASS per config for the sweep to be reportable. Treedepth saturation rate is Ji-Hoon's non-blocking implementer rec from 2026-05-14 (now mandatory under 6-seat ratification 2026-05-15).

stability_criterion.criterion: Qualitatively stable across all 36 configurations; specifically: §5.2.2 4-tier verdict (HARD/SOFT/PARTIAL/PASS) is unchanged across the 36 configurations.
stability_criterion.amber_condition: If the §5.2.2 verdict flips across configurations, T12 implementer reports the verdict-flip pattern as a QA-reviewable artefact alongside the headline posterior; the convening reads the full sweep table before consuming the headline verdict.
